themes_detail.label: Tree Damage & Overgrowth Surge
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree/branch complaints spiked to 19 THIS WEEK versus 2.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (+561%), and illegal tree damage complaints jumped to 4 last week versus 0.4 average (+967%), suggesting either rapid seasonal growth, storm damage, or lack of Parks maintenance enforcement in Jamaica/Hollis/St. Albans.
evidence: Overgrown Tree/Branches: 19 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.9 weekly baseline (z-score: 8.8, severity: high)
Illegal Tree Damage: 4 complaints last week vs. 0.4 baseline (+967% spike, z-score: 5.21)
Community board has repeated budget requests for 'park maintenance and safety' — pattern suggests chronic underresourcing
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept on whether staffing/budget cuts are driving inability to maintain trees before they become hazards
Document specific blocks in Jamaica/Hollis where trees are blocking sidewalks or damaging property; tie to DOT's repeated sidewalk repair budget request

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped to 5 last week versus 0.8 weekly average (+567%, z-score: 5.13), indicating either rapid illegal dispensary openings or residents newly reporting existing operations in Jamaica/Hollis/St. Albans.
evidence: Cannabis Retailer complaints: 5 last week vs. 0.8 weekly average (z-score: 5.13, severity: high)
No community board or council escalations yet noted, suggesting issue may not have reached elected officials' desks
reporting_angles: Map which blocks have cannabis retailer complaints; investigate if these are illegal unlicensed shops or licensed retailers residents object to
Interview NYPD or State Cannabis Control Board on enforcement activity in this district

themes_detail.label: Building Code & Construction Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints jumped to 40 last week versus 19.2 baseline (+108%, z-score: 5.83), and General Construction/Plumbing complaints spiked to 43 last week versus 13.0 baseline (+231%, z-score: 6.29), suggesting either unlicensed work, unpermitted alterations, or code violations amid 801 DOB filings in past 90 days (520 alterations).
evidence: Building/Use complaints: 40 last week vs. 19.2 baseline (+108%, z-score: 5.83, severity: high)
General Construction/Plumbing: 43 last week vs. 13.0 baseline (+231%, z-score: 6.29, severity: high)
801 total DOB permit filings in past 90 days, with 520 alterations (65% of filings), suggesting high construction activity without corresponding complaint follow-up
reporting_angles: Cross-reference DOB violation data with 311 building complaints; identify specific addresses with repeat violations
Interview DOB inspectors on whether enforcement staffing keeps pace with alteration volume in this district
Talk to residents on blocks with high complaint density about noise, dust, and safety during construction

themes_detail.label: Public Urination & Street Conditions
themes_detail.summary: Urinating in Public complaints jumped to 3 last week versus 0.4 baseline (+700%, z-score: 5.42), while Street Condition complaints remain high at 1,737 over 90 days; combined, these suggest deteriorating street management and potential sanitation/homeless services gaps in Jamaica/Hollis/St. Albans.
evidence: Urinating in Public: 3 complaints last week vs. 0.4 baseline (+700%, z-score: 5.42, severity: high)
Street Condition complaints: 1,737 over 90 days (6th highest category), chronic issue
Community board budget request for 'more on-street trash cans and recycling containers' suggests infrastructure gap
reporting_angles: Interview Parks or DSNY on whether recent cuts to public restroom maintenance or sanitation routes explain spike
Document specific parks or transit hubs where public urination is occurring; tie to lack of public facilities

themes_detail.label: Elevator Outages Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints rose to 24 THIS WEEK versus 12.4 weekly baseline (+94%, z-score: 3.55), indicating potential building maintenance failures or aging infrastructure in Jamaica/Hollis/St. Albans—particularly critical given high percentage of rental stock.
evidence: Elevator complaints: 24 THIS WEEK vs. 12.4 weekly baseline (+94%, z-score: 3.55, severity: high)
Correlates with 40 Building/Use complaints last week, suggesting broader building maintenance crisis
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings have repeat elevator complaints in 311 data; interview tenants about wait times and accessibility issues
Check DOB violation database for elevator-related violations in this district
